project.name: FandomVerse
project.description: A clean, responsive single-page portal built for fans who want everything in one place without the usual chaos of bouncing between a hundred tabs.
project.mission: To make fandom easier to enjoy by bringing together character profiles, trailers, galleries, merch, event updates, and release info in one place that actually feels usable.

teamMembers.name: Alexander Hayes
teamMembers.bio: Builds the structure and visual flow of the app so it feels smooth, easy to use, and not like a cluttered fan directory from the early 2000s.

teamMembers.name: Mei-Ling Chen
teamMembers.bio: Keeps the fandom content organized and readable, from character details to event and media data that actually makes sense when you browse it.

teamMembers.name: Marcus Aurelius Vance
teamMembers.bio: Handles the interactive bits, from the chatbot logic to the bookmark system and the shopping cart behavior that keeps the demo feeling alive.

teamMembers.name: Seraphina Vance
teamMembers.bio: Makes sure the site is still usable on mobile, easy to navigate, and not frustrating for anyone using screen readers or smaller screens.

techStack.name: Vite
techStack.role: Fast local build and development workflow

techStack.name: HTML5 Web Storage
techStack.role: Bookmarks, counters, and saved notes in the browser

techStack.name: Pre-scripted JSON Data
techStack.role: Fast content loading without a backend
